data.name: Amoritta
data.gender_notes: Amoritta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘amor’, meaning ‘love’. In ancient Greece, Amor was the god of love, passion, and desire. The suffix ‘itta’ is a diminutive, meaning ‘little’ or ‘small’. Thus, Amoritta means ‘little love’ or ‘small passion’. The name Amoritta carries the meaning “Little love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amoritta usually hope their child will grow to embody little love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name full of love and affection.
data.etymology: Amoritta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amoritta total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
